ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast silhouette; ratio of low-intensity (dark) to high-intensity (light) pixels is approximately 9:1 across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous dark pixel mass; a localized cluster of mid-to-high intensity pixels is visible on the inner-medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with a deep pixel depth; approximate 40-50 degree interior angle between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge is relatively smooth; right lobe trailing edge is characterized by extreme high-amplitude pixel variations and irregular jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a standard convex sweep; right lobe exhibits a truncated and non-uniform trajectory due to marginal irregularities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural deformity or tissue loss on the trailing edge and distal tip of the right lobe, resulting in a jagged, asymmetrical profile compared to the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry between lobes caused by the severe marginal truncation of the right lobe.
